An isolated little floating patch of uprooted earth carried into the air by one much larger ancient SKY TREE. A beautiful portrait 9:16 environment illustration for a hand-painted fantasy flying-ship mobile RPG. A tranquil, lonely, untouched stopping place in the clouds.

LAYOUT IS IMPORTANT: place the entire root-bound island in the UPPER-RIGHT quadrant, with its grassy top centered around 70 percent across and 35 percent down. The bottom of the hanging root mass must end ABOVE 65 percent image height. A large lush tree crown fills the upper-right and may be naturally cropped slightly by the top and right edges. Keep the central-left area and entire bottom 35 percent OPEN for a foreground ship that is NOT shown. A nearby island glimpsed beside the player's flight lane, not a giant tree filling the whole portrait. The visible near edge of the ground slopes DOWN-RIGHT on a diagonal, from about x=40 percent y=35 percent to x=95 percent y=52 percent. Broad quiet blue atmospheric space remains below-left of that line.

CAMERA: steep elevated bird's-eye 3/4 view, looking downward at about 60 degrees. See the TOP of the rounded leaf clusters, the broad grassy surface and the exposed root pattern on top of the earth. The trunk is visually foreshortened by the overhead angle. No eye-level tree portrait, no horizon. The viewer is above both the tree and the island, looking into the cloud-filled abyss below.

CONCEPT: the tree has pulled a SMALL CHUNK OF LAND out of the world with its roots. One mature large sky tree with a thick gracefully twisted warm-brown trunk and several spreading branches, luminous lime-green and golden-green layered foliage, dark emerald undersides. The tree canopy is substantially wider than the small landmass. The land is a compact asymmetrical torn slab of grass, crumbly brown earth and a few broken angular gray-beige boulders. Show a conspicuous intricate NETWORK OF THICK BROWN ROOTS gripping and wrapping the stones on the sides AND underneath, like a living woven basket holding the earth together. Thick roots emerge from the trunk, cross the grassy top, curl tightly around the broken rock edges and unite beneath the small land slab. Several thinner roots dangle freely under it, naturally tapering. Its underside is a compact irregular ROOT BALL with rocks trapped inside, not an enormous smooth cone of stone. Air is clearly visible around and beneath the entire suspended mass. A small patch of soft grass, a few tiny white and yellow wildflowers and two modest mossy stones provide quiet detail. No structures, paths or human-made objects.

ART DIRECTION: polished premium 2D mobile fantasy game painting, rich softly sculpted forms, detailed readable leaf clusters, beautiful warm wood grain in twisting roots, fresh vivid green grass, amber sunlight from upper-left, crisp natural edges and soft painterly shadows. Consistent with an ornate warm wooden skyship and bright green tree in the foreground. The sky around it is empty blue atmospheric depth with soft rounded white cloud banks FAR BELOW, pale blue shadows and gentle distance haze. Solitude without gloom. Only ONE tree and ONE small suspended root-bound island. No other islands, no nearby mountains, no water, no ship, no dock, no house, no signs, no flags, no cargo, no characters, no text, no UI, no border, no watermark. Small root-held island UPPER-RIGHT, canopy near the top edge, lower-left open cloud-filled sky, camera looking DOWN.
